title: Smoothly Improved
description: A Modpack which is made to only optimize, improve or smooth out the Minecraft experience.
body:
![SI Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/520975342402598c3484c6f3acdd72ac1a271acd.webp)
# Smoothly Improved [short: SI] 
Is an Modpack _(based on my preferences)_ which is focused around improving the minecraft expirience, with the least amount of Mods needed.

**Examples:**
- greatly increase your fps
- better Chunk generation an loading
- better light rendering engine
- optimized Memory[RAM] usage

## Mods in the Modpack:
**Listed Mods on here may differentiate on the version of the Modpack you are using**

- Sodium
- Sodium extra
- Concurrent Chunk Management Engine
- FerriteCore
- Lithium
- Noisium
- Entity Culling
- ModernFix
- ScalableLux
- BadOptimizations
- ImmediatelyFast
- More Culling
- Noisium
- Zoomify

_Other usefull Mods may be added in the Future_

> If there are any problems with the Modpack click on the link on the right sidebar: Report issues

> Please note that I am no professional about coding or modding Minecraft
> I know almost nothing, I just did this Modpack out of fun and for the Minecraft community
